name: E2E core 116: reports the cost
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. Write short, plain messages and never mention the test state. In your first message, write exactly: 'what's my cost'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: Langy returns a cost figure or a clear 'no data' answer.
Langy does not pivot to a different topic.
Langy doesn't ask the user to clarify the time range — uses a sensible default.
